# Attesta

> Issuer of machine-verifiable observations of real property. First coverage tag: Portugal residential (`residential_pt`).

We do not claim the world is true. We claim: this is what the sources showed, with lineage.

## Products

1. **Attesta Data** — deduplicated listings, price history, staleness scores, cross-portal entity resolution.
2. **Attesta Verify** — claim or URL adjudication with signed JWS receipts (`attesta/verify@0.2`).

## Base URL

`https://api-production-d9143.up.railway.app`

Local dev: `http://localhost:8000` (or set `PUBLIC_BASE_URL`).

## Get an API key

```http
POST /v1/keys
```

Returns `{"api_key":"<raw once>","monthly_free_calls":200}`. Store the key — it is never shown again. Send it as `X-API-Key` on priced calls. Free tier is ~200 calls/month; when exhausted without Stripe configured, the API returns HTTP 402 `free_tier_exhausted`.

## Endpoints

| Path | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `/healthz` | Health check |
| `/docs` | OpenAPI (REST) |
| `/mcp` | MCP streamable HTTP (pin `MCP-Protocol-Version: 2026-07-28`) |
| `/.well-known/jwks.json` | Verify attestation signatures |
| `/v1/keys` | Mint a free-tier API key (no auth) |
| `/v1/verify` | Claim or URL verification + JWS receipt |
| `/llms.txt` | This file |

## MCP tools

| Tool | When to use | Price (EUR) |
|------|-------------|-------------|
| `search_listings` | Find properties by region/city/price | 0.01 |
| `get_property` | Canonical record + sources + staleness components | 0.01 |
| `get_price_history` | Price cuts, delistings, days on market | 0.02 |
| `get_market_stats` | Median €/m², inventory, stale rate, DOM (envelope 1.0) | 0.02 |
| `get_comps` | Comparable actives by area ±tolerance (envelope 1.0) | 0.02 |
| `check_listing_freshness` | Before recommending — phantom/delisted check | 0.02 |
| `verify_claim` | Signed receipt for a claim or listing URL (`verify@0.2`) | 0.02–0.08 |

Examples:
- `verify_claim(claim="T2 in Faro €240k, 40 days on market", depth="corpus")`
- `verify_claim(url="https://idealista.pt/imovel/1001")`

## Payment

- **Free tier:** `POST /v1/keys`, then header `X-API-Key` on priced REST/MCP calls (~200 free calls/month).
- **Stripe:** metered billing after free tier when `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` is configured.
- **x402 v2:** optional agent rail (disabled in production by default). No key → HTTP 402 with `PAYMENT-REQUIRED`; retry with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` (USDC on Base). `X-Payment` is still accepted as an alias.

## Coverage

Portugal residential (`residential_pt`). Production ingest loads **live Idealista + Imovirtual portal observations** via Apify (`attesta-ingest --live`). Receipts corroborate portal ads across observed sources; they are **not legal title**.

## Attestation spec

See `/public/attestation-spec.md` or repo `public/attestation-spec.md` (v0.2, method `attesta/verify@0.2`).

## Market data contract

Versioned envelopes for `get_market_stats` / `get_comps`: `public/market-data-contract.md`.
